newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Suncorp-Metway sets A$250 mln of TCDs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Suncorp-Metway sets A$250 mln of TCDs.

text.p: Suncorp-Metway is issuing A$250 million of transferable certificates of deposit due March 15, 2002, joint lead manager SBC Warburg said on Friday.
The issue will carry a 6.0 percent coupon and will be priced on Tuesday at an indicative spread of 40 to 42 basis points over the March 2002 government bond.
The issuer is rated A minus by Standard and Poor's Corp, while the settlement date is on August 1.
The other joint lead managers are Bankers Trust, BZW, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Westpac.
